quiz.q: Who presided over the first session of the Indian National Congress?
quiz.why: Right. W. C. Bonnerjee presided over the 1885 Bombay session.

lines.say: The first session met in Bombay in 1885.
Twenty years later, the Partition of Bengal in 1905 turned it into a mass movement, and Non-Cooperation came in 1920.
